title.en: Compassionate practitioners amid customer service concerns

text.en: Client feedback regarding staff at this Brooklyn clinic shows contrast between caring appointments and administrative frustrations. Many reviewers praise veterinarians like Dr. Ona, Dr. Tai, and Dr. Morten for showing deep empathy and patience with fearful pets. Conversely, several clients report encountering indifferent communication during medical emergencies and unprofessional administrative handling.

Pet owners frequently highlight the compassionate handling shown to fearful, anxious, or reactive pets during physical examinations. Reviewers note that clinicians and technicians willingly get down on the floor to examine animals at their level, speaking softly and offering gentle physical comfort. Multiple clients credit this approach with easing stressful vet visits for both rescue dogs and cats.

title.en: Concerns over upselling and unexpected charges

text.en: Perceptions of pricing tilt notably negative, with several reviewers expressing concern over billing practices. Dissatisfied owners describe unexpected line items added to invoices without prior discussion and feel pressured into costly diagnostic testing beyond standard recommendations. While a few long-term clients found fees transparent or manageable on a budget, high walk-in surcharges drew sharp criticism.

q.en: Does the clinic accommodate urgent sick visits for existing patients?

a.en: Recent reviews note limited availability for same-day sick appointments, with some clients reporting delays of several days to weeks when pets fall ill.

q.en: How does the team handle reactive or highly nervous pets?

a.en: Owners of reactive and fearful pets report positive experiences, noting that staff take time on the floor to keep animals calm and comfortable.

q.en: Are price estimates provided before diagnostic testing?

a.en: While some clients report clear estimates, several critical reviewers caution that unexpected fees and extra diagnostics appeared on final invoices.
